description: Package-specific metadata for Nerves Compatibility Checker. Most packages won't need entries here. This file allows administrative overrides and system-specific filtering.

nerves.notes: This contains the Nerves tooling. You wouldn't use it on a device directly.

nerves_bootstrap.notes: This contains the Nerves tooling. You wouldn't use it on a device directly.

example_wifi_package.notes: This package requires WiFi hardware. Testing is skipped because it cannot be verified in a containerized environment. On real Nerves devices, ensure your target has WiFi support and required firmware.

_schema_notes.skip_if_depends_on: Global list of dependency names that will cause packages to be automatically skipped. If a package depends on any of these, it will receive a 'skip' status.
_schema_notes.forced_status: One of: 'pass', 'fail', 'skip'. When set, automated testing is bypassed and this status is shown instead.
_schema_notes.notes: Free-form text shown to users on the package page. Use to explain special requirements, caveats, or manual verification status.
_schema_notes.allowed_systems: If non-empty, only these systems will be tested. Use full package names like 'nerves_system_rpi4'.
_schema_notes.denied_systems: Systems in this list will not be tested. Use full package names like 'nerves_system_grisp2'.
